rounds.text: Ah, the brass lantern! Polished every morning, it has seen three sultans and one very confused goat. My asking price is **240 gold**. For a customer of your fine taste, I might be persuaded to come down, but I will be wounded while doing it. Name your number below, or accept my price and be done with it.
